fields.id: Stable slug, referenced by every record. Required.
fields.name: Human name of the source. Required.
fields.url: Landing page or file URL. Required.
fields.local_path: Path in this repo holding the snapshot, if any.
fields.adapter: Name of the adapter function that ingests it. Required.
fields.attribution: The citation string to reproduce when using it.
fields.retrieved: ISO date this snapshot was taken.
fields.scope: One line on coverage: geography, topic, period.
fields.record_kinds: Record kinds it can produce, from ('site_profile', 'site_capacity', 'site_compute', 'chip_spec', 'chip_price', 'chip_inventory', 'region_availability', 'benchmark_result', 'training_run', 'supply_metric', 'cost_model', 'reliability', 'geo_profile', 'citation'). Required.
fields.entity_types: Entity types it can create or describe, from ('company', 'accelerator', 'datacenter', 'cloud_region', 'component', 'country').
fields.fills: Dotted paths this source can populate, e.g. 'datacenter.power_mw'. Drives the fill step's precedence and the UI's 'fills' column. Required.
fields.trust: 0-1. Tie-breaker when two sources claim the same field. Primary/vendor/filing high, analyst model mid, aggregator low. Required.
fields.confidence_default: Confidence stamped on records lacking their own: ('confirmed', 'estimate', 'rumor').
fields.caveats: What this source is known to get wrong or omit.
fields.sample: Ids of representative records, filled by the builder.
fields.stats: {records, documents, entities, record_kinds{}} filled by the builder.

kinds.pipeline: An ingestion system with its own provenance model, ingested as a whole.
kinds.dataset: A published, downloadable dataset with a licence.
kinds.document-set: A set of individual documents (news, filings, vendor pages) cited per claim.
kinds.api: A queryable endpoint read at build time or snapshotted.
kinds.derived: A table produced by this repository from other sources.
kinds.registry: A directory or listing service used to enumerate facilities.

record_kinds.site_profile: Identity, location, operator and status of a data center.
record_kinds.site_capacity: Power capacity of a site at a date, current or planned.
record_kinds.site_compute: Installed or planned accelerator counts and H100-equivalents at a site.
record_kinds.chip_price: A rental or purchase price for an accelerator.
record_kinds.chip_inventory: A count of one chip type at one site on one date.
record_kinds.region_availability: Which accelerators a cloud region offers.
record_kinds.training_run: Compute, hardware and duration of a published model training run.
record_kinds.supply_metric: A supply-chain quantity: capacity, share, price, shipments.
record_kinds.cost_model: A modelled bill of materials or cost breakdown.
record_kinds.geo_profile: Geography of a place: ISO code, continent, containing country.
record_kinds.citation: A document cited as evidence, carrying no numeric payload of its own.

sources.name: Accelerator specification table
sources.attribution: Compiled from vendor datasheets and architecture whitepapers; see report/report.md for per-figure sourcing.
sources.scope: 49 accelerators from 12 vendors: process, memory, dense throughput at each precision, TDP, fabric, scale-up domain and unit price.
sources.caveats: All throughput figures are dense: vendor headline numbers that assume 2:1 sparsity have been halved. Unpublished values are blank rather than interpolated.

sources.name: Cloud accelerator pricing
sources.attribution: Vendor rate cards plus price trackers, per row.
sources.scope: 59 offers across 12 providers and 9 pricing tiers, per chip-hour.
sources.caveats: Marketplace and spot rows are host-set and volatile; the same silicon spans a 45x price range across tiers.

sources.name: Supply-chain metrics
sources.attribution: TrendForce, supplier disclosures, analyst estimates, per row.
sources.scope: CoWoS capacity and demand, HBM share and pricing, wafer prices, unit-shipment estimates and rack power, 2023-2027.
sources.caveats: No supplier reports HBM revenue separately, so share figures are estimates that disagree between sources by up to 20 points.

sources.name: Modelled bills of materials
sources.attribution: Raymond James teardown lineage, extended by Epoch AI, TrendForce and SemiAnalysis.
sources.scope: Six accelerators broken into logic die, HBM, packaging and assembly cost, with a modelled sell price.
sources.caveats: No vendor discloses per-part cost of goods; every figure is a model.
